build_sequence_example_parser: build a SequenceExampleParserBuilder to parse context and sequence features from a serialized SequenceExample
build_example_parser: build an ExampleParserBuilder to parse fixed-length and variable-length features from a serialized Example
build_feature_transformation_pipeline: build a _Builder pipeline that chains functions to transform features in a dictionary
build_filter_pipeline: build a FilterBuilder with filter functions to keep or drop examples by phase
get_fake_data_from_parser: get fake data from a SequenceExampleParserBuilder or ExampleParserBuilder for testing without real input
